package.name: crusader_link
package.description:
The boat's end of the UAV link. rxl_link_node decodes the RXL dialect off a radio -- and Ekko's own TUNNEL format (POSITIONS, LIGHTS), which is what the real aircraft sends -- and republishes both as the same ROS passage plan. It sends back the checkpoint request and, to Ekko, the BOAT packet (position and the map held).
It speaks MAVLink but it is NOT a second autopilot gateway: a different endpoint, a different dialect, and a message set with no command in it. It cannot arm, set a mode or move the boat. crusader_fcu/telemetry_bridge remains the only path to the Pixhawk, and the two never share a socket.
Version 0.1.0: the version counts capability proven, and nothing here has carried a frame over a real radio yet -- only UDP loopback against the bench.
